title: Ordinary finite quotients and adic fibres of an integral constructible heart object
statement:
Let $k$ be a field, let $\ell$ be a prime invertible in $k$, let $T$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], and fix a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $A$ and uniformizer $\varpi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. On the small pro-etale site put $B_T=\varprojlim_{n\ge1}(A/\varpi^n)_T$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Let $F$ be an object of the integral heart of [prop-weil-pbc-integral-tstructure] in the completed constructible category with compatible etale-origin witnesses [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete], and regard $F$ as its degree-zero sheaf of $B_T$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Write $QF$ for its image under raw rationalization [def-weil-pbc-rational-category], with adic geometric fibres normalized as in [lem-per-adic-heart-pullback-fibres].

For each $n\ge1$, the ordinary sheaf quotient $F_n=F/\varpi^nF$ is canonically of etale origin: there is a constructible sheaf $G_n$ of $(A/\varpi^n)_T$-modules on $T_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] with $\nu_T^*G_n\cong F_n$, where $\nu_T$ is the comparison morphism [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. The quotient maps give compatible transition maps $G_{n+1}\to G_n$ and $G_{n+1}/\varpi^nG_{n+1}\cong G_n$. There is one finite locally closed stratification of $T$ [def-constructible-stratification] on each stratum of which every $F_n$ is finite locally constant as a pro-etale sheaf and every $G_n$ is finite locally constant as an etale sheaf. Finite locally constant means locally isomorphic to a constant sheaf of a finite module.

For a geometric point $\bar x$ [def-weil-geometric-point], with etale stalks as in [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], put $P_{\bar x}=\varprojlim_n(G_n)_{\bar x}$. This is a finitely generated $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], the projections induce $P_{\bar x}/\varpi^nP_{\bar x}\cong(G_n)_{\bar x}$, and there is a natural isomorphism of adic coefficient fibres
$$(QF)_{\bar x}\cong P_{\bar x}\otimes_A E.$$
These identifications are natural in integral sheaf morphisms. In particular, if $u:B_T\to F$ is such a morphism, the induced maps $(A/\varpi^n)_T\to G_n$ are compatible and their values at $1$ determine $a_{\bar x}\in P_{\bar x}$; the fibre of $Qu$ sends $1$ to $a_{\bar x}\otimes1$. These are ordinary degree-zero quotients, not assertions that $F\otimes^L_{B_T}(A/\varpi^n)_T$ is concentrated in degree zero; torsion in the integral local models is allowed.

source.place: Definition 6.8.10 and Proposition 6.8.11(3) (integral heart and finite-module local models); Lemmas 5.1.2 and 5.1.4, Corollary 5.1.5 (finite discrete local systems and comparison); Lemma 6.8.2, Proposition 6.8.4(1), and Proposition 6.8.14(2) (completed/rational fibre normalization). The combined quotient and fibre comparison, including torsion local models, is agent-formulated from these results.
